summary: @or-sdk/source preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line, string-array-obfuscated, identifier-mangled bundle with the shape of an obfuscator.io output; its contents are unrelated to the package's advertised REST SDK purpose and cannot be inspected without executing under Bun. The Bun runtime is fetched and used solely to execute this opaque sibling bundle at install time, evading Node-oriented static inspection. Installing the package auto-runs this preinstall on any consumer machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
